text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista decided to enter the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup. A Tiara route race where 
she will face off against seasoned Senior 
Year competitors.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—"Buena Vista can fight even against 
Senior-tier Umamusume." "I want her to 
win." Today has arrived to answer those 
very expectations.
choice_data_list: Doesn't look like you're nervous at all.

Doesn't look like you're nervous at all, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I mean, wouldn't it be a waste 
otherwise?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
There are people who have been running for 
a loooong time... I need to learn a lot 
from them.
choice_data_list: Yeah, go grab as many as you can!
Yeah, go grab as many as you can!

text_block_list.name: Lady Petillant
text_block_list.text: Good day to you, Buena Vista-san♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Senpai! Let's have a great day together!"

text_block_list.name: Lady Petillant
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, calling me your senior! 
Track-record-wise, you surpassed me ages 
ago.

text_block_list.name: Lady Petillant
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, because it's the truth. Yes... 
Aptitude, talent, future potential. You 
are far above me in every way. ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However—opponents in the Senior class 
won't be easy to deal with.
